messages:
ops-bot: Incident: regional ingress surge in us-west1 causing elevated 5xx rates for hosted API. Detected at 07:13 UTC. Impact: ~12% of requests returning 502/504 intermittently for short tails. Status: mitigation in progress. Link: https://status.redwood.in/incident/2103456789 :rotating_light.

maria: TL;DR — root cause appears to be sudden fan-out from an upstream CDN failing health checks, causing burst connections to edge gateways and overload on the ingress proxy. We've applied temporary connection throttles at the edge and bumped worker count in us-west1.

ajay: Are any Dedicated or Private deployments affected or just Hosted?

sara: Dedicated clusters not impacted. Private (customer-managed) networks unaffected. Hosted-only so far. We're routing new traffic to us-west2 and applying prioritized-routing for customers with SLA.

leo: quick commands used: `kubectl scale deploy/edge-proxy -n hosting --replicas=40` and `edgectl throttle --path "/v1/generate" --max-conns 1200` — kept logs in /var/log/edge/ingress-2026-03-21.log if you need them.

support-liaison: Support note drafted and pushed to CSM channel. Customers with high error volume flagged; outreach for top 10 affected accounts started.

maria: Current mitigations summary: 1) edge connection throttle rolled out 07:18 UTC, 2) traffic steering to us-west2 07:20 UTC, 3) autoscale bump in us-west1 07:22 UTC. Visible error rate dropped ~60% since throttles but still degraded for some request patterns.

ops-bot: Update 07:45 UTC — error rate down to ~4%. Continued monitoring. If error rate stays <5% for 30m we'll start communicating recovery to customers. Next update in 15m or on change.

ajay: Any temporary feature flags we should disable? Which routes still noisy?

sara: No global feature flag flips yet. Noisy routes: realtime streaming and long-poll endpoints (/v1/stream, /v1/realtime). Avoid rolling model changes while we stabilize.

leo: Note for postmortem: capture CDN healthcheck churn and edge-proxy accept backlog metrics. I saved a snapshot to S3: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2103456789/metrics-snapshot.json

ops-bot: Update 08:15 UTC — mitigation holding, error rate stable ~2.1%. Routing/edge throttles remain in place while oncall and infra validate steady state. RCA: preliminary points above; full RCA due in 72 hrs. Closing note will be posted to status page once we mark resolved.

support-liaison: Customer outreach: initial notices sent to impacted accounts, will send follow-up with timeline after RCA draft.

maria: Leaving this thread for followups. Ping me or @sara if you see any regression. :white_check_mark:
